visualCharacteristics.summary: Expandable FAQ / disclosure rows with a plus-minus indicator; optional block heading; image-beside puts a feature accordion next to a picture.

contentPattern.structure: Optional heading row (one cell, a heading). Optional picture row (image-beside). Item rows [question] [answer]; the answer may hold paragraphs, lists, tables, links, or a single /fragments/ link.

usage: FAQ lists, disclosure / disclaimer panels holding tables, and key-benefit accordions beside an image. One item is open at a time.

suitableFor: regulatory disclosure and disclaimer panels (including tables)
product feature lists beside an image (image-beside)
